title: South Coast DTP ESRC Studentships 2027/28 entry
about: The ESRC South Coast Doctoral Training Partnership, United Kingdom, invites applications for social science PhD studentships for 2027/28 entry. Applicants submit one form to the host institution and one to the SCDTP by 16:00 GMT on 15 January 2027; some partners set earlier deadlines.

upskill.name: AI for Education Academy
why: No course scored at least 6 with a genuine match: the shortlist only matched the word "social" (social media marketing, social AI). Fallback to the AI for Education Academy page, which hosts research and academic productivity courses relevant to doctoral applicants in "Social sciences".
